locations.description:

locations.title: Blood Types
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Remember that Simon's blood type is A+, seen on his medical wristband.
- As seen on the [A+ Plaque](#loc=948533), the compatible blood types are O-, O+, A-, and A+.
- The blood bags in the previous room show the patients' blood types.
- Rotate the dials so that there are links from HM, TF and SW to Ordell.
- Press the Ordell button.

locations.title: Black Box
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Grab the [Disk Case Key](#loc=950593) and use it to unlock the [Disk Case](#loc=950590) here, retrieving [Floppy Disk x3](#loc=950594)
- Unlock another disk case in Atlas Computers to retrieve ["Fix-A-Disk!" Software](#loc=950599)
- Return to the computer, insert Fix-a-Disk, then insert Floppy Disk 2 of 3. Run the software.
- Insert disk 1, 2, and 3 in order.
- Turn on the printer by pressing the button.
- Print out the MANUAL.EML's attachment, [Reciprocating Compressor](#loc=950600)
- Use code 9-5-6 to unlock the black box.

locations.title: Black Box
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Take [Tape: Today](#loc=950619), [The Code Today](#loc=950617), and [Tape: Yesterday](#loc=950622); insert the latter into the tape player and hit 'play'.
- Grab [The Code Before](#loc=950701) and [Tape: Tomorrow](#loc=950700); play the latter.
- Grab [The Code After](#loc=950702) and [Tape: Do Not Play](#loc=950703); play the latter.
- Grab the [Back Door Key](#loc=950704) then play Tape: Today.
- Unlock [5 Upper Brae Back Door](#loc=950615) and grab the [Ammonite Disk](#loc=950705)
- Play Tape: Yesterday and put the disk into the computer's disk reader to receive [Current Count](#loc=950706)
- Play Tape: Today one last time, and insert code 129 to open the black box.

locations.title: Black Box
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Read the [Lamenting Poem](#loc=950790).
- A painting in the bedroom shows seven **boats**.
- A sketch in the next bedroom shows three **arches**.
- Downstairs, there's a total of six **children** in the pictures.
- Insert 7-3-6 to open the box.

locations.title: Projector
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Take the [Access Card - Level 3/4](#loc=952862) and use it to unlock a [P.R. Door](#loc=952878) on floor 3
- Go upstairs, take the [CEG Storeroom Key](#loc=953230), and use it to reach the [Projector Bulb](#loc=953238)
- With the [CEG Checkout Sheet](#loc=953237), unlock the [Finance Door](#loc=952875) and take the [Projector Lens](#loc=953245)
- Insert both parts and press the 'on' switch.
- Head to the mezzanine to collect the [Projector Slides](#loc=953309)
- Insert them in this order:
  - 1 / D
  - 2 / F
  - 3 / B
  - 4 / C
  - 5 / E
  - 6 / A
- Press Play.

locations.title: Console
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Use the elevator to go up a floor and grab the [Controller Key](#loc=953325)
- Go back down to ground level and grab the [Reference Sheet](#loc=953318)
- Find the control panel, insert the key, and input code A-5-D-7 to disable the alarm
- Next, go to the command console on the other side of the wheel and input code E-3-E-3
- Turn the wheel next to you so the pipes align
- Repeat this process on each floor; check the pipe from all angles to make sure it lines up
- Return to the ground floor; press 'Flow Test' and then 'IGNITE'

locations.title: Remote Systems Control
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Turn on both switches, then turn to camera 005 to see '2 5 4' written on Valve B.
- Press the buttons in screenshot #1 above, then press enter.
- Turn to camera 000 to see '103' written on filter unit A.
- Press the buttons in screenshot #2 above, then press enter.
- Take the [AUX Key](#loc=953430), use it to open the [AUX Door](#loc=953348), and solve the [AUX](#loc=953436) puzzle.
- Press the buttons in screenshot #3 above.
- Turn to camera 002 to see '781' written on the console.
- Press the buttons in screenshot #4 above, then press enter.
- Turn to camera 004 to see '592' written above the door.
- Press the buttons in screenshot #5 above, then press enter.
  - For additional supplies, you can repeat this process with doors:
  - [047](#loc=953443), [621](#loc=953444), [793 ](#loc=953445)
- Go down to the basement and turn [Valve F](#loc=953442).
- Take the [Clamp Release Procedure](#loc=953458), and turn your attention to the [Clamp Controls](#loc=953437).

locations.title: AUX
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Insert the [AUX Disk](#loc=953434) into the computer's disk reader to receive the [Auxiliary Lines](#loc=953435) clue.
- Start with the pipes facing the computer screen; look for any levers with **one** paint line nearby, then pull them to match the clue's "1" line:
  - | _ | | _ | _ | |
  - If you've done it right, the light will turn green.
- Repeat the process with line 2; it starts just above the first line's starting point.
  - | _ _ _ | _ _ | |
- And again with line 3; it starts by the door, and has some paint splotches a fair distance from its levers.
  - _ | | | _ | _ |
- Once all three lights are green, head back to the [Remote Systems Control](#loc=953428) puzzle.

locations.title: Clamp Controls
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Adjust Pressure Control (bottom left) to 'Set'
- Set Notify switches (top right) to both be 'On'
- Set Tension (top left) to both be 'Intermediate'
- Set Run Off (top right) to 'Disengaged'
- Adjust 'Intubate Flow' (bottom left) to 'None'
- In Clamp Connection (middle-left), type 'D71'
- Toggle Report switches (middle-right) to be On - Off - On - Off - Off - On
- Adjust Power (bottom-right) so Battery One is B, and Battery Two is C
- Light protection switches seemingly don't matter, so press 'Release'.
- Use the [Valve](#loc=953459).
